reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in his DM to say I'd noted Bay 21 for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups. I also told him I can't actually remember it for him: I have no way to save notes or preferences between conversations, and nothing that writes to his notes file. His message stays in our DM history, so he can look it up there. I suggested he add it to his own notes or the Quarrendon account profile if he wants it somewhere more permanent.

One line in my reply came out garbled: "What I said here is all I did." I meant that replying was the only thing I did.
